owner.name: Ayush Rai
owner.tagline: AI Engineer designing and shipping production LLM applications, RAG systems, and evaluation pipelines.

resumes.title: Resume
resumes.intro: This is the general resume. It collects the work I am ready to stand behind across software, AI systems, and product building. More focused versions live beside it when a role needs a narrower story.

resumes.title: Software Engineering Resume
resumes.intro: This version emphasizes systems I have built and shipped: APIs, CLIs, full-stack apps, and tooling where correctness and constraints mattered more than demos.

resumes.title: AI Resume
resumes.intro: This version focuses on production LLM applications, RAG systems, evaluation pipelines, and AI automation, with Python/FastAPI backend work and human-feedback evaluation programs.

resumes.title: Research Resume
resumes.intro: This version is for research-shaped conversations. It points to experiments, evaluation corpora, and questions I am still investigating rather than claims of finished science.

resumes.title: Product Resume
resumes.intro: This version highlights product judgment: choosing constraints, writing clear problem statements, and shipping surfaces people can actually run.

resumes.title: Security Resume
resumes.intro: This version centers host auditing, compliance tooling, and safety-first design choices such as read-only defaults and non-generative auditors.
